attempts.text:
Four groups are cut off by damaged roads, so they must be deferred. Car1 can only serve Jwalamukhi, and car2 handles the rest in two trips.

<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter jwalamukhi-care-home
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 jwalamukhi-care-home shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car2 trishuli-hospital syaphru-village
load car2 adult 2
drive car2 syaphru-village thakre-care-home
load car2 elderly 1
load car2 injured 1
drive car2 thakre-care-home trishuli-hospital
unload car2 adult 2
unload car2 elderly 1
unload car2 injured 1
drive car2 trishuli-hospital thakre-care-home
drive car2 thakre-care-home belkot-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 belkot-care-home bidur-school
load car2 injured 1
drive car2 bidur-school thakre-care-home
drive car2 thakre-care-home trishuli-hospital
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 injured 1
defer kakani-farm adult 3
defer kispang-farm adult 4
defer benighat-farm child 4
defer kalika-village adult 3
</plan>

COST: 577

Driving totals 137 minutes (car1 36, car2 101). Deferred penalties total 440: Kakani farm and Kalika village (3 adults each, 60 apiece), Kispang farm (4 adults, 80), and Benighat farm (4 children, 240). Kakani farm's only roads are damaged, Kalika village's only road is damaged, Kispang farm connects only through Likhu care home, which is cut off, and Benighat farm connects only to Dupcheshwar and Panchakanya, which cannot reach an evacuation point.
